question: What is the uncreated worth beside the made — and what, O Goddess, is ruled?
premises: by that standard, this uncreated is not worth a sixteenth part of the made
yet something here is prescribed by rule — what is it, O Goddess?
inference: The uncreated exceeds all measure; the verse turns to the Goddess for the rule.
uncertainties: sodasi kala (sixteenth part) proverbial measure, not computed; deveSi address marks dialogue form
plain_english: By that, this uncreated is not worth a sixteenth part — but what here, O Goddess, is prescribed by rule?
